name: Agent observability — North America mid-market and up

units.source: US and Canada companies with 200+ employees and a public engineering job posting in the last 12 months; Crunchbase and Greenhouse export, 2026-07-02

attach_rate.source: Share running enough autonomous agent workload to need dedicated observability; triangulated from our own 2026 install base where 31% of eligible accounts bought, and from the 38% of survey respondents reporting agents in production

annual_price.source: Blended realized ACV across 84 closed-won deals in FY2026, from the Salesforce closed-won report dated 2026-07-01

market_total.source: Published 2026 observability and APM market total for North America, taken from two vendor S-1 filings that disclose their own TAM methodology

share.source: Agent-specific workloads as a share of total observability spend; anchored on the 4-7% that container-native monitoring held three years into its own adoption curve
